editorial:
Imagine your favorite video game suddenly leaking into your living room. That is exactly what happens here when the game breaks out of the console and turns a normal city into a wild playground. You get to see the old crew back together, trying to stop giant animals and crazy traps from destroying their hometown. The vibe is super energetic and feels like a giant party where anything can happen. It takes the fun of the previous movies and flips it on its head by bringing the jungle to the streets, making every corner of the city feel like a new level you have to beat.

What really works is how the actors play off each other with great timing and funny lines. The action scenes are loud and colorful, though a few parts in the middle feel a bit slow. If you love big explosions and laughs, you will have a blast. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the wild creatures in detail, or maybe grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you want the best picture. It is the perfect pick for a family movie night.
endingExplained: The group finally finds the master console hidden in the city center. They have to work together to enter the final cheat code while fighting a massive boss monster. Once they type it in, a giant vacuum effect sucks all the jungle plants and animals back into the game. The twist is that the game evolves into a mobile app, meaning the danger is now in everyone's pocket, leaving the door open for more chaos later.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big adventures and comedies.
